title: FlatModuleCanonicalDerivedPullbackAux
statement: Choose shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let a:X → Y be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] with additive tensorPullback a [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let G be a tensor-flat structure-sheaf module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For every natural transformation ε:Qh ⋙ derivedPullback a → tensorPullback a on the homotopy category followed by Qh, making derivedPullback a a left-derived functor [def-pc-derived-pullback], the component ε at the homotopy single complex G[0] is invertible.

proof.text: Prove that the single complex is bounded above and termwise flat using the single-term isomorphism and flatness of zero objects. Apply flatComplexDerivedPullback. Identify its functor with tensorPullback via Functor.ext. The resulting counit is invertible by its equality with an isomorphism inverse. Mathlib leftDerived_fac_app expresses the given counit as the composite of this counit and leftDerivedLift; the lift is invertible by isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_leftDerivedLift. Compose the two isomorphisms.

theorem isIso_flat_single_derived_counit
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Y) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    (G : Y.Modules) (hflat : SheafOfModules.IsFlat G)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback a ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
    (hε : (derivedPullback a).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (0 : ℤ)).obj G))
